If ever a digit defined a brand and a feeling, it’s 3. Since 1975,
the BMW 3 Series has elevated what were ordinary trips into
extraordinary drives. Now comes the newest in the 3 Series
Sedan and Sports Wagon families. With 320 hp,1 TwinPower
Turbo technology, a host of corner-conquering chassis
enhancements, an 8-speed Sport Automatic transmission
or 6-speed manual,2 available Adaptive LED Headlights,
and a dynamic new take on classic styling that is even more
emotional, yet very much “3.”
1 340i and 340i xDrive.
2 6-speed manual is available only on select models.
Get the latest information on BMW standard and optional features, packages and
technical specifications. Visit bmwusa.com and select the BMW model of your choice.

An icon looks just right at any age. Our designers have always looked forward to evolving the styling of
the 3 Series to appear forever fresh, yet unmistakably “3.” A single glance at the front tells you that this
is a 3 Series with a new attitude. You encounter it in the “eyes” – signature BMW halo headlights with
the brilliance of available LED beams framing the famous kidney grille. Cast your glance across the body
and you’ll admire the crisp, sculpted surfaces, front to rear. At the rear, the athletic stance is strikingly
evident. As are light bars, arranged in the distinctive BMW “L” and, again, all LED. And it’s all formed into a
shape that has been optimized in BMW’s wind tunnel for minimal aerodynamic drag – and maximum fun.
Get the latest information on BMW standard and optional features, packages and technical specifications.
Visit bmwusa.com and select the BMW model of your choice.

CORNERING OFFICE.
How to design a legendary driving space: first, delight the driver. That’s a challenge we at BMW
eagerly accept. Displays, dials and controls are scientifically arranged for intuitive access, helping
you focus on the road ahead. BMW ConnectedDrive® keeps you connected, serving up critical
navigation and traffic information, as well as entertainment and mobile office options, at the
command of a touch. Sport seats hug you in just the right spots and, along with the leather-
wrapped sport steering wheel, make you feel like you’ve been with them forever. Which could
be the way you feel about staying inside a legendary BMW 3 Series.
Get the latest information on BMW standard and optional features, packages and technical specifications.
Visit bmwusa.com and select the BMW model of your choice.

THE MOVES OF
A CHAMPION, REFINED.
Since 1975, the BMW 3 Series racers have been no strangers to winner’s circles
around the world. The championship formula for the world’s original sports sedan
has always included near-perfect 50/50 front-to-rear weight distribution and
relentless refinement. The new 3 Series displays enhanced dynamics delivering
more precise steering, reduced body roll, greater directional stability – and driving
confidence. For an elevated sporting experience, an available Track Handling
Package adds Variable Sport Steering, Adaptive M Suspension, M Sport brakes,
and 18-inch light alloy wheels with Michelin® Pilot Super Sport performance tires.1
No matter the level of suspension you choose, do so knowing that it’s designed
with a focus on achieving the ultimate driving experience.
1 Performance tires include Mobility Kit and increased top-speed limiter; not recommended for driving in ice and snow conditions.
Get the latest information on BMW standard and optional features, packages and technical specifications.
Visit bmwusa.com and select the BMW model of your choice.

E NGINEERING A LEGEND.
A CONVERSATION WITH THE BMW 3 SERIES
DESIGN AND ENGINEERING TEAM:
What characteristics of the 3 Series do you strive to maintain and enhance?
A BMW 3 Series is the benchmark for dynamic design, being fun to drive and
offering all-day usability. We wanted to create a larger smile on the faces of our
customers when they are in the driver’s seat. For instance, the interior is the
typical BMW driver-focused orientation. This is important for a car that is driven
in a very sporty manner. We’ve also made many elements of the Sport Line
standard on 328i and 340i models, made a comprehensive improvement in
the chassis and introduced a new engine for the 340i and the 340i xDrive –
a six-cylinder with more performance that will create sheer driving pleasure.
As the team designed and developed the 3 Series suspension how did you
want the final product to feel to the driver?
More sporty! We’ve made improvements on all three chassis types – the
standard, M Sport and the Adaptive M Suspension chassis. By introducing new
damper technology and refined steering, the chassis has been made stiffer
for a sportier feel without compromising comfort. We recently drove the new
340i with Adaptive M Suspension on a handling course, and the precision of
steering combined with the light-footed, effortless handling through the tight
curves was amazing. That makes you look forward to the next curve!
Why is the 3 Series’ near-perfect 50/50 weight distribution so important to
its character and to the driver?
The near-perfect 50/50 weight distribution between the front and rear axles
makes a BMW superbly agile. The car benefits from a secure steering feel and
provides good traction even with heavy cornering loads. This, combined with
Dynamic Stability Control, means your BMW remains easy to control even in
extreme situations.
What will drivers of this latest 3 Series notice that’s different from
its predecessors?
First, they will see new headlights and a broader stance on the road. Our
customers will especially appreciate higher steering precision and improved
handling. In the interior, they will enjoy the new mix of materials: additional high-
gloss surfaces and chrome accents. Finally, information and communications
technology is even more important to our customers, and they will see
improvements here, too. For example, the navigation updates wirelessly via
the car’s 4G LTE connection.
Get the latest information on BMW standard and optional features, packages and technical specifications.
Visit bmwusa.com and select the BMW model of your choice.

shift lever knob (manual transmission only), exclusive and exhaust pipe finishers.
Aluminum Hexagon trim and more. This is serious stuff
